items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder if that's the school Mahalia Jackson went to... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Same school.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, McDonough 24 was in Carlton, and I mean, we had to walk around about 18 blocks of school, man. I mean, there wasn't no such a thing as school buses, you know.

I wonder if that's the school Mahalia Jackson went to. Same school. One of them up there. Same school. It's down near the river. Her church is on Milladon. That's right. And their school is only maybe near, yeah, right up in there. That's where. That's right. I've seen the school in a big white building. McDonough 24.
